summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 reported crash/bug fixes in Ledgr. All fixes VERIFIED PASSING with zero ReferenceError / 'is not defined' errors on any tested screen. (1) Settings 'doReset' — btn-reset-init opens 2-step danger-zone confirmation exposing btn-reset-confirm + btn-reset-cancel without runtime error; cancel path exercised (avoided data wipe). (2) Inventory-form 'confirmClose' — after entering actual stock 100, btn-close-init reveals btn-close-cancel + btn-close-confirm cleanly; cancel collapses back to btn-close-init as expected. (3) 'No way to add suppliers/items manually' — btn-add-supplier is present on Partners tab, opens New Partner form with input-supplier-name; created TEST_Supplier_QA appears in the Partners list. All add-entry paths work: btn-add-bill → /bill-form (New Vendor Bill with pre-selected supplier chip), tile-sales → /sale-form, tile-payments → /payment-form, tile-inventory → /inventory-form. Regression: Reports tab renders, Dashboard hero shows NET PROFIT $0.00 with Opening/Closing/Net Worth row, bottom tabs navigate cleanly. User claim (3) was indeed a symptom of the two crashes — add flows are functional.

critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx: doReset (lines 98–107) correctly gated by resetting state, calls api.resetAll(), toggles confirmReset off on success — implementation is clean.
inventory-form.tsx: closing/confirmClose states + closePeriod handler (lines 46–58) are correct; input-actual-stock validated before calling api.closePeriod. No stale-state issues seen.
Suggestion (non-blocking): both doReset and closePeriod success paths should optionally surface a toast/status before router.back(); currently the user only sees an abrupt navigation on success.

Voice mic FAB is present on Home but its testID is NOT 'btn-voice' — if voice-modal regression is needed next iteration, main agent should confirm the correct testID (mic icon at bottom-right).
rca_of_issue: Two failed search_replace edits in a prior iteration left JSX references to doReset (settings.tsx) and confirmClose/closePeriod (inventory-form.tsx) without their corresponding const/useState declarations. On mobile RN this manifested as red-screen ReferenceError the moment those screens rendered, blocking navigation to add-forms — which the user perceived as 'no way to add suppliers/items'. Fix (verified): added `const doReset = async () => {...}` before return in settings.tsx (lines 98–107) and added `const [closing, setClosing] = useState(false); const [confirmClose, setConfirmClose] = useState(false); const closePeriod = async () => {...}` in inventory-form.tsx (lines 46–58). Post-fix E2E paths for reset, close-period, add-supplier, add-bill, and all Home tiles run without any runtime errors.
